questions.question: Which Azure service hosts web apps and REST APIs without you managing the underlying servers?
questions.explanation: App Service is PaaS web hosting.

questions.question: What do you pay for in Azure App Service?

options.why: Correct. Size and number of instances.
Free tier is limited; most tiers are paid.

questions.explanation: Apps run on, and are billed by, an App Service plan.

questions.question: Which App Service feature enables zero-downtime releases?
questions.explanation: Deploy to a slot, then swap into production.
